Kids Bible Class · August — Week 1

God Made Everything, God Made Me

Genesis 1:1-31; Psalm 104

“How you made me is amazing and wonderful.”

Psalm 139:14 (NIrV)

God made everything — and God made you on purpose.

Image 1

In the very beginning, there was nothing at all.

Then God spoke — and there was light!

God made the bright sun, the gentle moon, and all the twinkling stars.

Image 2

God made the dry land and the deep blue seas.

He made tall mountains, flowing rivers, trees, and flowers of every color.

Image 3

Then God filled the world with animals!

Birds to fly, fish to swim, and creatures big and small — God made them all.

Image 4

God looked at everything He had made, and it was very good.

Then God made the very first people to know Him and enjoy His world.

Image 5

And God made YOU, too!

Out of the whole big world, God chose to make you on purpose.

God made everything — and you are part of His wonderful work.

What We Learn

God made the whole world — the light, the sky, the land, the animals, and people. And out of everything He made, God also made YOU. You are part of God's good and wonderful creation.

For you: When you see the sky, the trees, and the animals, remember: the same loving God who made all of it made you too — and He is happy He did.
